svg.title: Reset credentials with the Recovery Key
svg.desc: The current Recovery Key unwraps the existing DEK. The app authenticates the vault and confirms a new Master Password, saved replacement key and new Authenticator code before committing new wrappers. The vault ciphertext is preserved; success returns to sign-in rather than opening a session.
